## Objetivo
Deliver single-group setup, invite registration and session authentication APIs on T01 infrastructure. Own account migrations, password/session security and reusable private-route rejection tests. Account screens, shared navigation, styled controls and browser account journeys belong to T10, not this task.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] HTTP integration tests verify atomic first-member group creation, concurrent setup producing exactly one group, invite-only later registration, invalid invites, case-insensitive duplicate names, salted scrypt password storage, valid/invalid login, generic rate-limited login failures, HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies, Secure under HTTPS, expiry/logout and cross-origin unsafe rejection. Session tokens are hashed at rest; password/session secrets are absent from API JSON. Only setup status, registration and login are public.
- [ ] Account migrations run repeatedly without duplication. Closing/reopening the application against the same explicitly injected temporary SQLite file preserves accounts and unexpired sessions. Tests never access the development database. Reusable authorization test helpers verify signed-out rejection of implemented private account/member/group endpoints and provide a matrix extended by resource-owning tasks. Future resource tests belong with those implementations.
- [ ] npm test, npm run typecheck and npm run build pass. The full suite retains T01's neutral-shell smoke coverage; no account browser journey or account UI is required until T10.
